title: The Cautious step on the ice
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：cautious　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cautious 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the builder wrote of ① a cautious step on the ice in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more cautious than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the cautious ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most cautious step on the ice anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1969 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too cautious to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the cautious ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a cautious word about money, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as cautious as the word about money they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was cautious or not, and he said so.

By 1982 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something cautious, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite cautious; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the cautious ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1985, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another cautious step on the ice in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more cautious than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most cautious word about money in the whole site, she said in 1987, was the one she could never quite name; the cautious ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 谨慎（前置定语 a cautious step on the ice：1975 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件谨慎的一步）
B. adj. 谨慎／小心翼翼（比较级 more cautious than：文中两处，一处比冰上的一步，一处比预想）
C. adj. 谨慎／小心翼翼（最高级 the most cautious：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 谨慎（表语 too cautious to do：母亲觉得它太谨慎，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 小心翼翼（前置定语 a cautious word about money：叔叔把整件事称作一桩小心翼翼的措辞）
F. adj. 小心翼翼（同级比较 as cautious as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩谈钱时的措辞相比）
G. adj. 小心翼翼（后置定语 something cautious：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 小心翼翼（受程度副词修饰 quite cautious：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: a cautious step on the ice
the most cautious step on the ice anybody
The most cautious word about money in

answers.why: cautious 意为“谨慎”，1975 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件谨慎的一步”，此处作前置定语 a cautious step on the ice。
cautious 意为“谨慎”，此处用比较级 more cautious than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
cautious 意为“谨慎”，施工图上 十月 那行字说它是工地里最谨慎的一件，故用最高级 the most cautious step on the ice。
cautious 意为“谨慎”，母亲认为这件东西“太谨慎了，谁也用不上”，too cautious to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
cautious 意为“小心翼翼”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩小心翼翼的措辞”，此处作前置定语 a cautious word about money。
cautious 意为“小心翼翼”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩谈钱时的措辞一样小心翼翼”，同级比较用 as cautious as。
cautious 意为“小心翼翼”，施工图上那半行字要的是“小心翼翼的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something cautious。
cautious 意为“小心翼翼”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当小心翼翼”，quite 修饰原级 cautious。
cautious 意为“小心翼翼”，1985 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要小心翼翼”，故用比较级 more cautious than。
cautious 意为“小心翼翼”，母亲 1987 年说的是“整个工地里最小心翼翼的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most cautious word about money。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件谨慎的一步。（a cautious step on the ice）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更谨慎。（more cautious than …）
母亲觉得它太谨慎，谁也用不上。（too cautious to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩小心翼翼的措辞。（a cautious word about money）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩谈钱时的措辞一样小心翼翼。（as cautious as …）
到了 1982 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件小心翼翼的东西。（something cautious）
answers: In 1975 the builder wrote of a cautious step on the ice in the plan.
Everybody said it was more cautious than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too cautious to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a cautious word about money.
He said nobody would call it as cautious as the word about money they had once had.
By 1982 the plan asked for nothing but something cautious.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 cautious 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the builder wrote of a cautious step on the ice in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most cautious step on the ice in the site, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too cautious to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a cautious word about money, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite cautious, and everybody laughed.
The cautious ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
